info.name: UAM API – E2E Happy Path Flow (23 Steps, Fully Automated)
info.description:
═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  UAM API – End-to-End Happy Path Test Execution
═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════

PURPOSE:
  Validates the core functionality of all UAM APIs in a
  realistic user lifecycle flow with ZERO manual updates.

FLOW (23 Steps):
  01. Authenticate → store JWT token (auto-refreshes)
  02. List All Roles (reference baseline)
  03. Get All Users (count baseline)
  04. Get All Users V2 (status baseline)
  05. Create Test User test.user01
  06. Get User → validate creation
  07. Get User V2 → Status = Enabled
  08. Has Role → validate role assignment
  09. List Groups for User
  10. Update User (multiple fields)
  11. Get User → verify updated fields
  12. Disable User
  13. Get User V2 → Status = Disabled
  14. Enable User
  15. Get User V2 → Status = Enabled
  16. Lock User
  17. Get User V2 → Status = Locked
  18. Unlock User
  19. Get User V2 → Status = Enabled
  20. Delete User (soft delete)
  21. Restore User
  22. Get User V2 → validate restored
  23. Delete User (final cleanup)

FULLY AUTOMATED:
  • Token fetched + cached in Step 01, injected in all steps
  • TranRefNum auto-increments per step (no duplicates)
  • UserName/Email/Role pulled from Environment variables
  • Change testUserName in env → entire flow runs for that user

HOW TO RUN:
  1. Import collection + environment
  2. Select environment
  3. Click Run → Run collection
  4. Click Run (Runner) — all 23 steps execute sequentially

RERUNNABLE:
  If Step 5 fails (user already exists), change testUserName
  in the environment or run Step 23 manually to clean up first.

request.description: POST /API/DeleteUser – Final cleanup. Removes the test user created in Step 5, leaving the environment clean for the next run.
